deviations.summary: DataFusion 55 Parquet filter pushdown and filter reordering are explicitly disabled while pruning remains enabled. Enabling both changed the reviewed scoped-query physical plan by duplicating the application-owned predicate, so the compatibility-preserving posture is encoded as a closed runtime-evidence enum rather than inherited defaults.

The packet-local wave5, gate-b, and rebuild-equivalence paths remain blocked only by the pre-existing golden-corpus digest mismatch recorded at activation; wave3, vacuum dry-run, focused upgrade checks, root checks, Clippy, and extractor gates pass.

failed_approaches.summary: The first target configuration enabled Parquet filter pushdown and reordering; snapshot review exposed a duplicated scoped predicate, so the generated pending snapshot was discarded and the explicit compatibility posture was changed to disabled.

deviations.summary: The exact pinned delta-rs revision supports same-version checkpoint creation and exact-version reopen without checksum drift; fresh full-stat reloads remain the supported policy and no same-handle skip-stats mutation was introduced.
The packet-local wave5 and rebuild-equivalence paths retain the inherited golden-corpus digest mismatch and no target-stack snapshot or golden digest was accepted to conceal it.

failed_approaches.summary: A first direct structured-scan probe used an incompatible binary comparison for the fixture column type; it was replaced with a type-correct Boolean predicate before the provider/pruning contract was recorded.

deviations.summary: The pinned revision persists num_retries=0 in Write operationMetrics. Update, delete, and optimize metric schemas omit a retry field, so those operations retain coordinator-owned with_max_retries(0) while retry telemetry is explicitly non-applicable rather than promoted into a new application contract.

Direct target-library optimize and vacuum compatibility remains isolated in tests because production has no vacuum orchestration. The probe is dry-run-only, validates relative non-traversing action paths, and proves keep_versions protects the rollback-required version.

Wave6 and the root/rebuild families continue to fail only at the activation-recorded golden-corpus profile digest mismatch; root check, Clippy, wave3, vacuum dry-run, focused upgrade, mutation/publication recovery, maintenance, and bidirectional revision compatibility checks pass.

failed_approaches.summary: The first telemetry assertion expected every DML and maintenance operationMetrics object to expose num_retries. The exact target revision exposes it for Write only; tests now distinguish persisted zero for Write from explicitly non-applicable telemetry for Update, Delete, and Optimize.

The maintenance probe initially named chrono::TimeDelta without a direct dependency, then used an inferred Default that Clippy rejected. A context-inferred helper now compile-probes the API without expanding the manifest and passes Clippy.

deviations.summary: The cross-revision benchmark uses an ephemeral benchmark target because repository doctrine permits exactly one permanent top-level Rust integration-test target; the stable recipe creates, measures, and removes that temporary target without expanding the committed test topology.

The activation-recorded golden-corpus failure was a stale metadata digest rather than changed corpus bytes. WP06 corrected the generated profile metadata through the sole model writer, then proved clean rebuild equivalence and an empty fact differential instead of accepting changed facts.

Cross-worktree model reproduction exposed path-bearing compiler-tool identities. The model compiler now derives worktree-relative source identity and builds its two Rust tools with path remapping, disabled debug data, and non-incremental compilation; exact generated artifacts match across isolated worktrees.

The exact revision comparator now invokes revision-driver tests with --include-ignored so the same driver covers the WP01 baseline, where tests were ordinary, and the target, where environment-driven tests are ignored by routine suites.

The first full benchmark comparison reported one noisy checkpoint-reopen regression while all correctness and resource checks passed. A controlled rerun with no concurrent gates and unchanged thresholds/statistics passed all six workloads; target peak RSS was 79478784 bytes against the 1073741824-byte ceiling.

The operational rollback window remains OPEN. No production namespace was deployed or mutated during this repository implementation; preserved revision fixtures and exact commit identities remain the rollback evidence described by the operational handoff.

failed_approaches.summary: The first benchmark output serialized workload maps in lexical rather than declared workload order, which made the comparator reject semantically complete results; serialization was corrected to retain the predeclared workload order.

The initial cross-revision driver used --ignored and selected zero baseline tests because the WP01 tests were not ignored. The driver now uses --include-ignored and proves both historical and target revisions.

An intermediate attempt removed macOS linker UUIDs to suppress nondeterministic model-tool identity, but binaries without LC_UUID could not be executed by dyld. The final implementation retains runnable binaries and removes nondeterministic path/debug inputs with -Cdebuginfo=0 and path remapping.

One advisory-policy invocation observed a transient RustSec database update race. A subsequent exact-policy run completed without repository changes and confirmed the three registered, owner-bound exceptions.

Old-state target mutation, exact time travel, metadata, application transactions, no-op and real DML, fault recovery, concurrency, checkpoint/optimize/vacuum safety, protocol non-elevation, and bidirectional persisted-format compatibility are green at the proving commit.
